rounds.question: How many subway riders (MTA's 'Subway' mode in data.ny.gov dataset sayj-mze2, which includes the Staten Island Railway) will the MTA report in total for Monday 2026-11-30 to Sunday 2026-12-06, New York time?
rounds.unit: riders per Monday-to-Sunday week (MTA estimated subway ridership)
rounds.resolve: the sum of the seven Subway counts 2026-11-30 to 2026-12-06 in the sayj-mze2 CSV download archived under sources/mta_daily/ in the window Sat 2026-12-12 00:00 to Sun 20:00 ET (the first archived capture with all seven days posted; a resolution-only download up to 2026-12-15T17:00:00Z may stand in; none by then and the round is cancelled); card mta-subway-weekly@v2
rounds.pilot_note: P1, unscored pilot (go/no-go gate). Posted, locked, hashed and resolved by the full rules, and never scored. Holiday flag (364-day comparison misaligned): Veterans Day 2026-11-11 is compared with 2025-11-12 (the holiday fell on 2025-11-11) in the reference weeks.
